ValidationRule.description: Blocks setting Status to Submitted unless Amount is filled and at least one Collateral exists.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c) ), OR( ISBLANK(Amount__c), Collateral_Count__c < 1 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Loan Application cannot be set to Submitted without at least one Collateral record and an Amount.
